rationale: The module-level stop(args) does test_env = TestEnvironment.read_from_file(), a @classmethod that returns cls(...), and then calls test_env.stop(). TestEnvironment is the only class in the file with a stop method. The resolver cannot infer the return type of a classmethod returning cls(...) (receiver_type_unknown), and no in-scope rule describes that pattern.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior fp-novel verdict is correct and names the right mechanism, the classmethod cls(...) factory return.
